sections.title: Scope
points: The platform brokers hunting opportunities: hunting leases, hunting permits, driven hunts, trophy and guest hunts and hunting helpers, each as an offer or a wanted listing.
No sale of weapons or ammunition.

sections.title: Account
points: One account per person, with truthful information.
Using the platform requires accepting the terms of use and the privacy policy.

sections.title: Listings
points: Listings are reviewed before publication.
Contact details do not belong in listing texts. Contact runs through the chat after sign-in.
Listings expire and can be extended.

sections.title: Moderation
points: Listings can be rejected, sent back for changes or removed. You receive the reason.
Accounts can be blocked for serious or repeated violations.
You can appeal decisions: placeholder.

sections.title: Reporting
points: Listings, profiles and messages can be reported. The content guidelines describe what is not allowed.

sections.title: Ending use
points: You can delete your account at any time.

sections.title: Liability and changes
points: Placeholder.

sections.title: Controller and contact
points: Name and address of the operator: placeholder, see the legal notice.
Contact for data protection questions: placeholder.

sections.title: Account and sign-in
points: Email address, sign-in codes and, if used, Sign in with Apple.
A session cookie keeps you signed in (see cookie settings).
Accounts that are never confirmed are deleted after 7 days.

sections.title: Profile and listings
points: Display name, account type, business name, country and language.
Listings with texts, prices, game species and photos.
Photos are re-encoded on our server. This removes metadata such as GPS coordinates.

sections.title: Location
points: Public pages show only the region or district, or a deliberately shifted point.
The postal code and the exact location of a hunting ground are never shown publicly.

sections.title: Messages
points: Messages between users are stored for the conversation and delivered in real time.
Email notifications about new messages can be switched off.
People you have blocked cannot write to you.

sections.title: Saved searches
points: Filters, frequency and matches of your saved searches. They run for 6 weeks unless you extend them.
Every email contains a one-click unsubscribe link, valid for 90 days.

sections.title: Map
points: The map is served from our own server. No requests go to third-party map providers.
The map stores nothing in your browser.

sections.title: Verification
points: Optional: an uploaded hunting licence or similar document is stored privately and is visible only to you and to administrators.
The document is deleted 30 days after the decision.

sections.title: Reports and moderation
points: Reports, moderation decisions and their reasons.
Copies of reported messages are kept for 12 months after the report has been handled.
The record of administrative decisions is kept pseudonymised for 24 months.

sections.title: Deleting your account
points: You can delete your account at any time after signing in again.
Profile, listings, photos, messages, saved searches and documents are deleted immediately.
Only pseudonymised moderation records and reports concerning the account remain until their deadlines.

sections.title: Data export
points: You can download all your data as a JSON file in your account.

sections.title: Hosting and processors
points: Database, file storage and sign-in: Supabase, region EU (Frankfurt).
Email delivery: provider to be named.
Backups and logs at the hosting and email providers are kept until their own deadlines (to be named).

sections.title: Your rights
points: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, objection and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority: placeholder.

Legal.outlineNote: This outline lists what the platform actually processes. It is not a legal text.

guidelines.title: Content guidelines
guidelines.intro: These rules apply to all listings, profiles and messages. Violations lead to rejection or removal and, if repeated, to an account block.

sections.title: Only hunting opportunities
points: Every listing must fit one of the categories.
No sale, purchase or exchange of weapons, ammunition or weapon parts.

sections.title: Prohibited content
points: No illegal, discriminatory, threatening or sexual content.
No offers that violate hunting law, for example hunting during closed seasons.
No texts copied from other websites and no photos you do not hold the rights to.

sections.title: Truthful and complete
points: Information must be complete and plausible.
No duplicate listings for the same opportunity.

sections.title: Contact and privacy
points: No phone numbers, email addresses or links in listing texts. Contact runs through the chat.
No exact coordinates of hunting grounds and no personal data of other people.

sections.title: Messages
points: No spam, harassment or attempted fraud.
You can report messages and block people.

AccountDelete.title: Delete account
AccountDelete.intro: Deletion is final and starts immediately after confirmation. It cannot be undone.
